description: Keep Dockerfile downloads pinned by version + sha256 up to date. Annotate each pin as `# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<package>`, then `# sha256: <URL with ${VERSION}>`, then `ARG <NAME>_VERSION=<version>`, with `ARG <NAME>_SHA256=<hex>` below. Renovate moves the version; the .github/actions/pinned-downloads action recomputes the sha256 on the PR. Add `custom.regex` to enabledManagers if the repository sets them.

packageRules.description: Pinned downloads: wait 3 days after a release (a pulled or re-tagged release does not reach us), one PR per repository.
